dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the first field of a base iteration record; in the target this is the stored real dimensionFactor d_k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The selected forward-error envelope is multiplied by d_k. The iteration constructor assumes 1 ≤ d_k, but d_k is stored rather than computed from n or k.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of field 25 of a base iteration record, namely the computed approximate solution xHat in R^n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is compared with the system's exact solution in the relative forward error appearing in both existential conclusions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: A semantics record determined by predicates small and secondOrder on real numbers, together with an assumption secondOrder(0).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It controls the applicability smallness assumption and the permitted remainder in the final approximate inequality. Neither predicate has quantitative axioms beyond secondOrder(0).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: The progression-law proposition for a family: iteration 1 is well-conditioned, and for every 0 < k < n, failure of well-conditioning at k+1 implies the current iteration satisfies the progression predicate LocalDef035.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: A proof of this proposition is required separately in each right and flexible branch and supports the finite selection of a candidate index.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of field 4 of a core iteration record, denoted etaR.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: In the right branch it appears in the reapplication term um·etaR·K_M and in the corresponding applicability gain bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of field 5 of a core iteration record, denoted rhoAR.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It multiplies the matrix-error contribution ua·K_A·rhoAR in both envelopes.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of field 3 of a core iteration record, denoted ua.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It scales the matrix perturbation contribution in the flexible and right error envelopes.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of field 1 of a core iteration record, denoted ug.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It scales the GMRES contribution ug·K_AM·K_M in both error envelopes.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of field 2 of a core iteration record, denoted um.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It occurs only in the right envelope, through um·etaR·K_M.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of a right-preconditioner package for a family. Its constructor stores MR and MRinv, two-sided inverse assumptions, an inverse assumption for A·MRinv and MR·Ainv, MR ≠ I, and ML = MLinv = I.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All condition gains and right/flexible iteration records depend on this strongly restricted preconditioner package.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: The flexible appendix package. Its constructor stores a rule producing a flexible decomposition-and-estimate package at every candidate satisfying well-conditioning, terminal-or-progression, and flexible applicability.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: An inhabitant is universally supplied to the flexible branch. If no such package exists, that universal branch is vacuous.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef012
dependency_coverage.meaning: The flexible applicability proposition for one flexible iteration. Its constructor requires core applicability and a componentwise bound on the solution-basis perturbation by gmresMagnitude·|zHat|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target assumes a proof of this proposition for every candidate satisfying the two preceding candidate conditions, not merely for the ultimately selected candidate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef013
dependency_coverage.meaning: A flexible-method package consisting of a family, a preconditioner for that family, and a stored flexible iteration for every candidate k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The second top-level conjunct is universal over every inhabitant of this type.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef014
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the family from a flexible-method package.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the system, basis family, base iterations, and selected xHat used in the flexible conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef015
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the stored flexible iteration at candidate k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its core fields determine the flexible envelope at the existentially selected candidate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef016
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the preconditioner from a flexible-method package.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines K_M and K_AM in the flexible error envelope.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef017
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the core record from a flexible iteration.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It exposes ug, ua, rhoAR, and the other core magnitudes used by applicability and the final bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef018
dependency_coverage.meaning: The right appendix package. Its constructor stores a rule producing a right decomposition-and-estimate package at every well-conditioned candidate that is terminal or satisfies the progression predicate and is right-applicable.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: An inhabitant is universally supplied in the right branch; nonexistence of such an inhabitant makes that branch vacuous.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef019
dependency_coverage.meaning: The right applicability proposition for an iteration. Its constructor requires core applicability, nonnegative reapplication magnitude, solution perturbation bounds, and reapplicationMagnitude ≤ d_k·um·etaR.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target demands it at every candidate satisfying well-conditioning and terminal-or-progression, rather than only after choosing the witness.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef020
dependency_coverage.meaning: A right-method package consisting of a family, a preconditioner, and a stored right iteration for every candidate k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The first top-level conjunct is universal over every inhabitant of this package type.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef021
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the family from a right-method package.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the base iterations and system appearing in the right existential conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef022
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the stored right iteration at candidate k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its core and reapplication data determine the right envelope at the selected candidate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef023
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the preconditioner from a right-method package.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines the right-preconditioner and preconditioned-system condition gains.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef024
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the core record from a right iteration.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It exposes ug, um, ua, etaR, and rhoAR for the right envelope.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef025
dependency_coverage.meaning: A two-constructor choice type selecting either Frobenius-norm condition gains or induced-two-norm condition gains.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The same selected norm convention is used consistently in K_A, K_M, K_AM, applicability, appendix estimates, and both final envelopes.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef026
dependency_coverage.meaning: The candidate-index type {k : Nat | 0 < k and k ≤ n}.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Each existential witness is a stored subtype value in the range 1 through n; it is not a dimension computed by the proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef027
dependency_coverage.meaning: A family package containing a system, a nested basis family for that system, and a stored base iteration for every candidate index.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the common data source for progression, preconditioning, and forward-error conclusions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef028
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the basis family from a family package.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its n-by-k basis matrices enter the progression matrix, exact preconditioned operator, and iteration decompositions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef029
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the stored base iteration at candidate k from a family package.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies d_k, xHat, vHat, spectral data, and computed quantities used throughout the target.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef030
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the linear-system package from a family.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies A, its inverse, left preconditioners, b, and xExact.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef031
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of field 7 of a system package, namely xExact.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the denominator reference vector and exact solution in the relative forward error.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef032
dependency_coverage.meaning: Approximate inequality: ApproxLE_semantics(lhs,rhs) means there exists a real r such that secondOrder(r) and lhs ≤ rhs + |r|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Both existential conclusions use this relation, so each bound includes an existential scalar remainder governed only by the arbitrary secondOrder predicate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef033
dependency_coverage.meaning: Relative Euclidean forward error ||xHat - xExact||_2 / ||xExact||_2.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the left-hand side of both selected-candidate bounds. Division is Lean's total real division.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef034
dependency_coverage.meaning: The well-conditioning predicate 1/sigmaMin(vHat) ≤ 4/3 and sigmaMax(vHat) ≤ 4/3.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is required of the existentially selected candidate and is an antecedent of applicability. There is no explicit assumption sigmaMin > 0.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef035
dependency_coverage.meaning: For every real phi > 0, the augmented n-by-(k+1) matrix [phi·MLinv·b, MLinv·A·Z_k] has a unit vector x with ||[phi·MLinv·b, MLinv·A·Z_k]x||_2 strictly below d_k(ug_k+epsilonC_k) times that matrix's Frobenius norm.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the nonterminal progression alternative. It is assumed at k when well-conditioning fails at k+1 and is one of the antecedents under which applicability must be supplied.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef036
dependency_coverage.meaning: The flexible envelope F = ug·K_AM·K_M + ua·K_A·rhoAR.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The flexible relative error is bounded by d_k·F up to an existential secondOrder remainder.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef037
dependency_coverage.meaning: The right envelope R = ug·K_AM·K_M + um·etaR·K_M + ua·K_A·rhoAR, with the displayed left-associated grouping.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the right selected-candidate bound and is asserted universally to equal the flexible envelope plus um·etaR·K_M.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef038
dependency_coverage.meaning: K_M, the choice-dependent condition gain of MR with stored inverse MRinv.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It multiplies the GMRES term and, in the right branch, the reapplication term.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef039
dependency_coverage.meaning: The base iteration-record type indexed by system, semantics, basis family, and candidate k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It stores rather than derives the numerical quantities, decompositions, approximate solution, and spectral certificates used by the theorem.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef040
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of field 3 of a base iteration, the progression parameter ug_k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Together with epsilonC_k it sets the threshold in LocalDef035; it is not explicitly equated to the core field ug used in the final envelope.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef041
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of field 5 of a base iteration, a stored scalar error quantity used as epsilonB in the core constructor assumptions.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Core construction assumes this stored base-iteration error is exactly zero; it does not appear directly in the final bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef042
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the n-by-k matrix vHat from a base iteration.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its singular-value certificate determines well-conditioning and its columns enter right-iteration perturbation bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef043
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the spectral certificate attached to vHat.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its stored sigmaMin and sigmaMax are exactly those used by LocalDef034.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef044
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructor taking arbitrary predicates small and secondOrder and only a proof secondOrder(0).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It confirms that small has no required members or numerical meaning and that secondOrder need satisfy no closure, asymptotic, or magnitude law beyond containing zero.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef045
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the secondOrder predicate from the semantics record.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It constrains appendix remainders and the existential scalar remainder in the final approximate inequalities.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef046
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructor for the progression law: it assumes LocalDef034 at k=1 and assumes, for every natural 0 < k < n, that not LocalDef034 at k+1 implies LocalDef035 at k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The argument named mgs already contains these two assumptions; the target does not prove them.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef047
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of sigmaMax from a spectral certificate.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms the second inequality sigmaMax ≤ 4/3 in well-conditioning.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef048
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of sigmaMin from a spectral certificate.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its reciprocal forms the first well-conditioning inequality, without a positivity guard.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef049
dependency_coverage.meaning: The core perturbation-and-gain record for a family, preconditioner, and candidate.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its first five scalar fields and condition-related construction assumptions ultimately generate both error envelopes.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef050
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of MR from a preconditioner package.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is used in K_M, in the inverse of A·MRinv, and in exact right-preconditioning assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef051
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of MRinv from a preconditioner package.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the applied right inverse in iteration decompositions and in K_M and K_AM.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef052
dependency_coverage.meaning: Preconditioner constructor requiring MR and MRinv to be two-sided inverses; A·MRinv and MR·Ainv to be two-sided inverses; MR ≠ I; and system ML = I and MLinv = I.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These are constructor assumptions, not consequences of the target. They restrict all quantified preconditioners to exact, nonidentity right preconditioning with identity left preconditioning.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef053
dependency_coverage.meaning: Flexible appendix constructor from a function which, for each k, turns well-conditioning, terminal-or-progression, and flexible applicability into a LocalDef087 decomposition package.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The appendix argument already assumes availability of the exact decomposition and gain estimates encoded by LocalDef087 at every applicable candidate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef054
dependency_coverage.meaning: Flexible applicability constructor requiring core applicability and |solutionBasisDelta(i,j)| ≤ gmresMagnitude·|zHat(i,j)| for every i and j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It identifies the exact extra solution-formation perturbation estimate hidden inside each flexible applicability proof.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef055
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructor of a flexible-method package from a family, preconditioner, and a stored flexible iteration for every candidate k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: No iteration is computed by the target; the complete indexed family of iterations is supplied as data.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef056
dependency_coverage.meaning: The flexible iteration-record type, containing a core and a solution-basis perturbation decomposition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Flexible applicability and appendix estimates are indexed by these stored records.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef057
dependency_coverage.meaning: Right appendix constructor from a function which, for each k, turns well-conditioning, terminal-or-progression, and right applicability into a LocalDef090 decomposition package.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The supplied appendix already assumes the right error decomposition and contribution bounds for every applicable candidate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef058
dependency_coverage.meaning: Right applicability constructor requiring core applicability; reapplicationMagnitude ≥ 0; componentwise solution-basis perturbation bounded by gmresMagnitude·|vHat|; Frobenius solution-preconditioner perturbation bounded by reapplicationMagnitude·||MRinv||_F; and reapplicationMagnitude ≤ d_k·um·etaR.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These estimates are hypotheses packaged into right applicability and yield the additional um·etaR·K_M term.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef059
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructor of a right-method package from a family, preconditioner, and a stored right iteration for every candidate.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target quantifies over supplied iteration data rather than defining an iterative algorithm.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef060
dependency_coverage.meaning: The right iteration-record type, containing a core, basis and preconditioner solution perturbations, an exact reconstruction equation, and a reapplication magnitude.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its fields underlie right applicability, the appendix decomposition, and the right envelope.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef061
dependency_coverage.meaning: The first norm-choice constructor, selecting the Frobenius condition gain.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Under this choice every K(B) equals ||Binv||_F·||B||_F.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef062
dependency_coverage.meaning: The second norm-choice constructor, selecting the induced two-norm condition gain.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Under this choice every K(B) equals ||B||_2·||Binv||_2.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef063
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of a nested basis family associated with a system.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its basis matrices Z_k define the exact projected operator, progression matrix, and approximate-solution decompositions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef064
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the n-by-k basis matrix at each natural k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For candidate k it supplies Z_k with dimensions n by k.val.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef065
dependency_coverage.meaning: Family constructor from a system, a basis family, and one stored base iteration for every candidate.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All candidate-specific numerical records are constructor inputs rather than values derived by the theorem.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef066
dependency_coverage.meaning: The n-dimensional linear-system package type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its constructor enforces n > 0, invertibility data, b ≠ 0, and A·xExact = b for every actual family.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef067
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real vector space represented as functions Fin n → Real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All exact solutions, approximate solutions, right-hand sides, coefficient vectors, and contribution vectors use these finite dimensions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef068
dependency_coverage.meaning: Column-prepending operation: from b in R^n and C in R^(n×k), it forms [b,C] in R^(n×(k+1)).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It constructs the augmented progression matrix and the two block matrices in the Arnoldi and least-squares assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef069
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Frobenius norm of a finite real matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears in the progression threshold, Frobenius condition gains, and perturbation-magnitude assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef070
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that the natural numeral 3+1, namely 4, is at least two and can therefore be cast as a real numeral.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports the literal 4 in the well-conditioning constant 4/3 and adds no mathematical hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef071
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that the natural numeral 2+1, namely 3, is at least two and can be cast as a real numeral.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports the nonzero literal denominator 3 in 4/3.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef072
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a matrix A and threshold t, the proposition that there exists a Euclidean unit vector x with ||Ax||_2 < t.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the existential near-null-vector statement inside every positive-phi instance of the progression predicate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef073
dependency_coverage.meaning: The left-preconditioned right-hand side MLinv·b.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: After scaling by phi, it is the first column of the progression matrix and is also the exact quantity underlying computedB.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef074
dependency_coverage.meaning: The left-preconditioned matrix product MLinv·A·Z.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For Z_k it is the exact projected operator underlying computedC and the non-first columns of the progression matrix.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef075
dependency_coverage.meaning: Choice-dependent condition gain: Frobenius product ||Ainv||_F||A||_F for the first choice, or induced-two product ||A||_2||Ainv||_2 for the second.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines all three gains K_A, K_M, and K_AM.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef076
dependency_coverage.meaning: K_AM, the selected condition gain of A·MRinv with stored inverse MR·Ainv.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears in the GMRES contribution of both envelopes and in the smallness maximum.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef077
dependency_coverage.meaning: K_A, the selected condition gain of system A with stored inverse Ainv.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears in the matrix contribution ua·K_A·rhoAR.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef078
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Euclidean norm ||x||_2 = sqrt(sum_i x_i^2) of a finite real vector.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines relative errors, singular-value certificates, least-squares residuals, progression witnesses, and appendix contribution ratios.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef079
dependency_coverage.meaning: Base-iteration constructor storing d_k with 1 ≤ d_k; scalar error parameters; computedC and deltaC with computedC = MLinv·A·Z_k + deltaC; computedB and deltaB with computedB = MLinv·b + deltaB; an Arnoldi-style exact equality [computedB,computedC] = vHatNext·[beta·e1,H] with H upper Hessenberg and vHat its first k columns; least-squares perturbation data and yHat; spectral certificates for computedC and MLinv·A·Z_k; xHat and deltaX with xHat = Z_k·yHat + deltaX; and a spectral certificate for vHat.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All these exact decompositions and certificates are constructor assumptions. The theorem neither computes them nor proves the Arnoldi, spectral, or xHat decomposition identities.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef080
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of real n-by-n matrices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is used for A, inverses, left and right preconditioners, and square perturbations.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef081
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of real m-by-k matrices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It enforces every matrix dimension through Fin m and Fin k indices.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef082
dependency_coverage.meaning: A spectral-bound certificate for a matrix, storing nonnegative sigmaMin and sigmaMax, global lower and upper Euclidean gain inequalities, and, when the column dimension is positive, unit vectors attaining both bounds.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For vHat it makes sigmaMin and sigmaMax actual attained extremal gains, but it still permits sigmaMin = 0.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef083
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of field 16 of a core record, the nonnegative-under-applicability gmresMagnitude.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Applicability bounds it by d_k·ug and appendix estimates use it to control the GMRES and solution-basis perturbations.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef084
dependency_coverage.meaning: Core constructor storing ug, um, ua, etaR, rhoAR; zHat; columnwise preconditioner perturbations satisfying zHat_j = (MRinv+DeltaMR_j)vHat_j; matrix perturbations satisfying computedC_j = (A+DeltaA_j)zHat_j; exact basis identities Z_j = zHat_j + Ainv·DeltaA_j·zHat_j; assumptions deltaC = 0, epsilonC = 0, deltaB = 0, epsilonB = 0; and three raw perturbation magnitudes.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These decompositions and zero-error statements are assumed by construction. Numerical bounds on the perturbations are added only by LocalDef117.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef085
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of zHat from a core record.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears in preconditioning decompositions, the flexible solution perturbation bound, rhoAR, and the appendix contribution analysis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef086
dependency_coverage.meaning: The core applicability proposition constructed from nonnegativity, exact least-squares and perturbation assumptions, gain bounds, a positive denominator for rhoAR, the exact rhoAR ratio, and semantics.small of a specified maximum.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is a prerequisite for both flexible and right applicability; if the arbitrary small predicate rejects the required value, applicability may be uninhabited.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef087
dependency_coverage.meaning: The flexible appendix result package at a candidate, constructed from a three-term-plus-remainder exact error decomposition and contribution estimates.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The flexible appendix assumes such a package at every candidate meeting all its antecedents.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef088
dependency_coverage.meaning: Flexible-iteration constructor storing a core, solutionBasisDelta, and the exact identity xHat = (zHat + solutionBasisDelta)·yHat.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This exact solution-formation decomposition is an input assumption, not a conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef089
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of solutionBasisDelta from a flexible iteration.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its componentwise bound is required by flexible applicability.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef090
dependency_coverage.meaning: The right appendix result package at a candidate, constructed from a four-term-plus-remainder exact error decomposition and contribution estimates.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The right appendix stores a rule yielding this package for each applicable terminal-or-progression candidate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef091
dependency_coverage.meaning: Right-iteration constructor storing a core, solutionBasisDelta, solutionPreconditionerDelta, the exact identity xHat = (MRinv+solutionPreconditionerDelta)·((vHat+solutionBasisDelta)·yHat), and a reapplication magnitude.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The reconstruction identity and raw magnitude are assumed data; right applicability supplies their numerical bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef092
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of reapplicationMagnitude from a right iteration.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Applicability bounds it by d_k·um·etaR, generating the right-only envelope term.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef093
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of solutionBasisDelta from a right iteration.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Right applicability assumes its entries are bounded relative to corresponding vHat entries.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef094
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of solutionPreconditionerDelta from a right iteration.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its Frobenius norm is controlled by reapplicationMagnitude·||MRinv||_F in right applicability.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef095
dependency_coverage.meaning: Basis-family constructor requiring each Z_k to have injective matrix-vector action when 0 < k ≤ n and requiring the first k columns of Z_(k+1) to equal Z_k whenever k < n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Full column rank and nestedness are constructor assumptions for every family used by the target.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef096
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of A from a system package.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: A defines the exact system, condition gain K_A, projected operator, and matrix perturbation assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef097
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of Ainv from a system package.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the stored two-sided inverse used in K_A, K_AM, and core basis decompositions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef098
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of ML from a system package.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The preconditioner constructor requires ML = I.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef099
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of MLinv from a system package.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It left-preconditions A and b, and the preconditioner constructor requires MLinv = I.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef100
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of b from a system package.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The constructor assumes b ≠ 0 and A·xExact = b; MLinv·b is used in computed and progression quantities.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef101
dependency_coverage.meaning: Every system package carries a proof 0 < n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: No system, family, right package, or flexible package can inhabit dimension n = 0.

binders: For every natural number n, every semantics record consisting of predicates small and secondOrder with secondOrder(0), and either of the two norm-gain choices.

Independently for the right claim: for every right package containing a family, a right preconditioner, and one right iteration for each k with 0<k≤n; for every proof of the progression law for that family; for every right appendix package; and for every applicability function defined at all candidates satisfying the stated antecedents.

Independently for the flexible claim: for every flexible package containing a family, a right preconditioner, and one flexible iteration for each k with 0<k≤n; for every proof of the progression law; for every flexible appendix package; and for every applicability function defined at all candidates satisfying the stated antecedents.
Independently for the envelope identity: for every family, every preconditioner for it, and arbitrary real ug, um, ua, etaR, and rhoAR.
The right and flexible existential witnesses have separate scopes and need not be the same k. Both share only the outer n, semantics, and norm choice.
hypotheses: Every actual system already has n>0, square A and Ainv that act as two-sided inverses, square ML and MLinv that act as two-sided inverses, b≠0, and A·xExact=b.
Every preconditioner already stores mutually inverse MR and MRinv, mutually inverse A·MRinv and MR·Ainv, MR≠I, and the exact identities ML=I and MLinv=I.
Every basis family already has full column rank for 0<k≤n and nested columns from k to k+1.

Every base iteration already stores d_k≥1, computed quantities and exact perturbation equations, an Arnoldi-style equality with an upper-Hessenberg matrix, xHat=Z_k·yHat+deltaX, and spectral certificates.
The supplied progression proof already assumes well-conditioning at k=1 and assumes that, for every 0<k<n, failure of well-conditioning at k+1 implies the progression predicate at k.

For each branch, applicability must be supplied for every candidate k satisfying well-conditioning and satisfying k=n or the progression predicate. It is not merely requested for a candidate selected afterward.
Flexible applicability packages core applicability and the componentwise solution-basis perturbation estimate |DeltaZ(i,j)|≤gmresMagnitude·|zHat(i,j)|.

Right applicability additionally assumes nonnegative reapplicationMagnitude, |DeltaV(i,j)|≤gmresMagnitude·|vHat(i,j)|, ||DeltaMR||_F≤reapplicationMagnitude·||MRinv||_F, and reapplicationMagnitude≤d_k·um·etaR.

Core applicability already assumes all sign conditions, exact least-squares minimization, relative least-squares perturbation bounds, preconditioner and matrix perturbation bounds, gmresMagnitude≤d_k·ug, basisPreconditionerMagnitude≤d_k·um·etaR, matrixMagnitude≤d_k·ua, a positive denominator for rhoAR, the exact rhoAR ratio, and semantics.small of a five-term maximum.

The flexible appendix already assumes an exact decomposition xHat-xExact=g+m+r, secondOrder(||r||/||xExact||), and the two contribution estimates ||g||/||xExact||≤gmresMagnitude·K_AM·K_M and ||m||/||xExact||≤matrixMagnitude·K_A·rhoAR.

The right appendix already assumes an exact decomposition xHat-xExact=g+p+m+r, secondOrder(||r||/||xExact||), and the three estimates for g, p, and m using gmresMagnitude·K_AM·K_M, reapplicationMagnitude·K_M, and matrixMagnitude·K_A·rhoAR.
conclusions: The exact top-level conjunction is RightClaim ∧ (FlexibleClaim ∧ EnvelopeIdentity). Thus it contains three conjuncts, with the latter two grouped together.

RightClaim: there exists a candidate k with 0<k≤n such that 1/sigmaMin(vHat_k)≤4/3 and sigmaMax(vHat_k)≤4/3, and there exists a real r with secondOrder(r) such that ||xHat_k-xExact||_2/||xExact||_2 ≤ d_k·[ug_k·K_AM·K_M + um_k·etaR_k·K_M + ua_k·K_A·rhoAR_k] + |r|.

FlexibleClaim: there exists, independently, a candidate k with 0<k≤n satisfying the same two well-conditioning inequalities, and there exists a real r with secondOrder(r) such that ||xHat_k-xExact||_2/||xExact||_2 ≤ d_k·[ug_k·K_AM·K_M + ua_k·K_A·rhoAR_k] + |r|.
EnvelopeIdentity: for arbitrary real ug,um,ua,etaR,rhoAR, the right envelope equals the flexible envelope plus (um·etaR)·K_M.

The selected witness is asserted only to be well-conditioned and to satisfy the approximate forward-error bound. The conclusion does not retain a statement that it is terminal, satisfies the progression predicate, is applicable, or carries an appendix decomposition.
mathematical_definitions: A candidate is a stored subtype value k with 0<k≤n. Its dependent matrix dimensions use the stored natural k.val; neither existential branch computes k.
For a vector x in R^q, ||x||_2=sqrt(sum_i x_i^2). Matrices are finite real matrices; ||·||_F is the Frobenius norm and ||·||_2 on square matrices is the induced Euclidean operator norm.
For the first choice, K(B,Binv)=||Binv||_F||B||_F. For the second choice, K(B,Binv)=||B||_2||Binv||_2.
ApproxLE_semantics(lhs,rhs) means there exists r∈R such that secondOrder(r) and lhs≤rhs+|r|.
Progression(k) means that for every phi>0 there exists x∈R^(k+1) with ||x||_2=1 and ||[phi·MLinv·b, MLinv·A·Z_k]x||_2<d_k(ug_k+epsilonC_k)||[phi·MLinv·b, MLinv·A·Z_k]||_F.
The progression-law argument assumes WellConditioned(1) and, for every 0<k<n, not WellConditioned(k+1) implies Progression(k).

The base-iteration constructor assumes computedC=MLinv·A·Z_k+deltaC, computedB=MLinv·b+deltaB, [computedB,computedC]=vHatNext·[beta·e1,H], that H is upper Hessenberg, that vHat is the first k columns of vHatNext, and that xHat=Z_k·yHat+deltaX.
The core constructor assumes zHat_j=(MRinv+DeltaMR_j)vHat_j, computedC_j=(A+DeltaA_j)zHat_j, Z_j=zHat_j+Ainv·DeltaA_j·zHat_j, and deltaC=epsilonC=deltaB=epsilonB=0.
Flexible iteration construction assumes xHat=(zHat+solutionBasisDelta)yHat. Right iteration construction assumes xHat=(MRinv+solutionPreconditionerDelta)((vHat+solutionBasisDelta)yHat).
rhoAR is assumed exactly equal to || |zHat||yHat| ||_2/||zHat·yHat||_2, with ||zHat·yHat||_2>0.
The smallness argument is max(ug·K_AM, ug·K_M, um·etaR·K_M, ua·K_A·rhoAR, ua·K_AM·K_M).

The envelope identity is algebraic expansion and reordering of real sums. It is not literal syntactic definitional equality because the summands are grouped and ordered differently, but it has no independent numerical or analytic content.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every dimension, semantics record, and choice of Frobenius or induced-two condition gains, the proposition simultaneously gives a right-method existence claim, a flexible-method existence claim, and a universal algebraic relation between their envelopes. In each method claim, after universally receiving a fully constructed family of iteration data, a progression proof, an appendix rule, and applicability at every well-conditioned terminal-or-progression candidate, one may select some stored index k between 1 and n. At that k, the stored vHat spectral data satisfy 1/sigmaMin≤4/3 and sigmaMax≤4/3, and the relative Euclidean forward error is at most the stored dimension factor times the corresponding condition-gain envelope, plus the absolute value of an existential real accepted by the arbitrary secondOrder predicate. The right envelope has the flexible GMRES and matrix terms together with the additional reapplication term um·etaR·K_M. The third conjunct says exactly that adding this term to the flexible envelope gives the right envelope for arbitrary real parameters.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The semantics predicates are arbitrary. small may be always true, always false, or anything else. secondOrder is constrained only by secondOrder(0), with no asymptotic, closure, sign, or magnitude law.

If secondOrder contains only 0, the final relation reduces to the ordinary bound lhs≤rhs. If secondOrder contains all reals or sufficiently large values, the existential remainder can make the relation extremely weak or automatically satisfiable.

If small rejects every real, core applicability is uninhabited. This can make the universally quantified applicability argument nonexistent and hence make the surrounding universal claim vacuous rather than yield a substantive bound.

The dimension n is universally arbitrary, including n=0. System construction requires n>0, so at n=0 the quantified right, flexible, family, and preconditioner types have no inhabitants and all three top-level conjuncts are vacuous.

For n>0, any impossibility in constructing a system, family, nonidentity exact preconditioner, per-k iterations, progression proof, appendix package, or applicability function likewise creates vacuity through a universal binder over an uninhabited type or proposition.

Applicability is required at all candidates satisfying WellConditioned(k) and (k=n or Progression(k)), not merely at the existentially selected candidate. For candidates where either antecedent is false, its curried implications impose no obligation.
The progression-law implication is vacuous at any k where the next iteration remains well-conditioned, and its universal range is empty when no natural k satisfies 0<k<n, notably when n=1.
The positive-phi implication inside Progression(k) imposes no condition for nonpositive phi, although positive real phi do exist.

The existential right and flexible indices are independent stored subtype witnesses. The target does not define an algorithm for finding them, and it does not expose why the selected witness was terminal or satisfied the progression condition.
The quantity dimensionFactor is an arbitrary stored real constrained only by 1≤dimensionFactor. No formula connects it to n, k, a square root of a dimension, or any other dimensional quantity.

Base-iteration ug and epsilonC used by the progression predicate are stored fields. The supplied declarations do not state an equality between base-iteration ug and the core ug used in the final envelope.

Real division is total. In particular 1/0=0 in Lean, so sigmaMin=0 satisfies the reciprocal inequality 1/sigmaMin≤4/3. The spectral certificate allows sigmaMin=0, making this a genuine degenerate well-conditioning route.

The denominator ||xExact|| is not guarded at each displayed ratio. For constructible systems, b≠0 and A·xExact=b imply xExact≠0 and hence ||xExact||>0, but the formal division operation would still be defined at zero.
The denominator in rhoAR is explicitly guarded by ||zHat·yHat||>0. The fixed denominator 3 in 4/3 is nonzero.

The core, flexible-iteration, right-iteration, appendix, system, preconditioner, basis, and base-iteration decompositions are constructor assumptions. The proposition does not derive these exact equations from executable computations.

The selected conclusion omits applicability, terminality, the progression predicate, all appendix contribution vectors, and all individual perturbation bounds; it retains only well-conditioning and the compressed approximate forward-error inequality.
The identity between right and flexible envelopes is only real additive reassociation and reordering after unfolding definitions. It asserts no new stability estimate.
The universal envelope identity quantifies over arbitrary real ug,um,ua,etaR,rhoAR without sign assumptions. Nonnegativity is imposed only inside core applicability for actual applicable iterations.

Strict near-null inequalities can be impossible for degenerate thresholds, for example a nonpositive threshold since norms are nonnegative. In that event Progression(k) is false, potentially discharging implication antecedents elsewhere.
Universals over Fin n or Fin k can be vacuous at zero dimensions in general constructor types. In target-relevant system and candidate records, n>0 and k>0 make those principal index sets nonempty.

No probability model, floating-point semantics, machine precision, convergence theorem, asymptotic order relation, or executable relation between successive stored iterations is encoded beyond the listed predicates and constructor equations.
ambiguities: The names small and secondOrder suggest conventional numerical-analysis interpretations, but the declaration intentionally leaves both interpretations unspecified beyond their exact predicate types and secondOrder(0).

Several inductive records contain stored scalar fields that are not used by the target dependency boundary. Their external numerical interpretation cannot be recovered, although every field that affects the proposition is determined by its projection and use.
The term dimensionFactor has no encoded formula or dimensional interpretation; only its type, stored status, and lower bound 1 are determined.
